zh: 巴塞隆納依偎迷濛的海灣
en: The hall within, empty and still
Early autumn's setting sun sways the tree shadows
At the foot of the mountain
Barcelona nestles against a hazy bay
Should carry away what's in the painting
Leaving behind a vast expanse of deep black?
Let that touch of pale blue in the corner
Seeping into the memories of days to come?
Taking away only the untainted white?
One can put ink to paper
Painting over what is called indifference
Painting something for no particular reason at all

points.zh: 米羅 ( Joan Miro  1893–1983 ) 是西班牙三大畫家之一，和畢加索，達利齊名。以超現實手法，簡約圖相，表現如夢似幻的詩意。他的畫蘊藏著異想天開，反覆無常和幽默的趣味。加上扭曲的動物，變形的有機物體和異乎尋常的幾何構造，使作品顯得特别。明亮濃麗的色彩，尤其是藍，紅，黄，綠，黑和留白，鋭利的線條，點和花樣，架構成無形狀的阿米巴圖 ( Amorphous Amoebic )。 米羅的畫風，總是有一種天真、無邪、貪玩的風格。他以單純的記號和直樸原素做畫，達到現代畫自由表現的境地，其作品雖然幻想，神秘，表現卻是明晰，畫面充滿了隱喻，幽默與輕快，表現孩童般的純樸天真，並且富有詩意。他主張繪畫所表現的神秘，必須以具體的自然形象作基礎。米羅是一名超現實主義的畫家，他企圖要摧毀理性和邏輯的主宰，把無意識和非邏輯心靈的衝力從中解放出來，並且探測不可見領域和視覺世界的奧祕。
points.en: Joan Miro (1893–1983) is one of the three great Spanish painters, alongside Picasso and Dali. Using a surrealist approach and simplified imagery, he expressed a dreamlike, poetic quality. His paintings are filled with whimsy, unpredictability, and humor. Combined with distorted animals, deformed organic shapes, and unusual geometric constructions, his works stand out as distinctive. His bright, rich colors — especially blue, red, yellow, green, black, and blank space — along with sharp lines, dots, and patterns, construct amorphous, amoeba-like shapes. Miro's style always carries a sense of innocence, purity, and playfulness. Using simple marks and unadorned elements, he achieved a realm of free expression in modern painting; although his works are fantastical and mysterious, their expression is clear, filled with metaphor, humor, and lightness, expressing a childlike simplicity and innocence, and rich in poetry. He held that the mystery expressed in painting must be grounded in concrete natural forms. Miro was a Surrealist painter who sought to destroy the dominance of reason and logic, releasing the impulses of the unconscious and illogical mind, and probing the mysteries of the invisible realm and the visual world.
